description: K₂Na₂Sb₂H₂OF₁₀(H₂O)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. The structure consists of four H₂O clusters inside a K₂Na₂Sb₂H₂OF₁₀ framework. In each H₂O cluster, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. O is bonded in a water-like geometry to two equivalent H atoms. In the K₂Na₂Sb₂H₂OF₁₀ framework, K is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten F atoms. There are a spread of K-F bond distances ranging from 2.79-3.09 Å. Na is bonded to one O and five F atoms to form distorted NaOF₅ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaOF₅ octahedra and corners with five equivalent SbF₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 17°. The Na-O bond length is 2.44 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.41 Å. Sb is bonded to five F atoms to form distorted SbF₅ square pyramids that share corners with five equivalent NaOF₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-29°. There are a spread of Sb-F bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.17 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 1.00 Å. O is bonded in a water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two H atoms. There are five inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, and one Sb atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, and one Sb atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, and one Sb atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, and one Sb atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, and one Sb atom.
